title: The Dispute Among PhD’s in Islam
body:
The “scholars of Islam” who claim they are scholars are hiding what Allah has sent down (in the Holy
Qur’an), and they are the first ones who are responsible (for that knowledge).
••••••••••• •••••••• •••••••••••••
waqifoohum innahum mas’uloon. Stop them, for they will be asked. (37:24)
On the Day of Judgment they will be stopped because they are responsible. Allah Almighty will ask them,
“Why did you not follow My orders, as I informed you through Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-akhireen? Why did
you not follow Me, as this responsibility will give you the most harsh punishment?” They did not enforce
Shari`ah Muhammadiyya (s). They will be tortured on the Day of Resurrection, and they will be like thirsty
beasts moving around a well. The most severe punishment will be for them! Curses on those who claim they
have knowledge! Where is your knowledge? Do we narrate fables, or do we inform you about the words of
Allah Almighty, All-Knowing?
If you claim you know then go ahead, tell them what you know and don’t say to me, “Why are you
informing?” I don’t have an order. If asked who are the God-fearing, they say, “Those who do some
practices,” but you are doctors: Dr. Filler Alhery, Dr.Sultan Alhery, Dr. Filler Mashary.

“Dr. Filler, which doctor are you?
“We are doctors but we have learned to open hearts.”
“Are you from this kind?”
“No we imitate the wisdoms that came from the time of the Prophet (s).”
“We understand these and we are hard working on it.”
“The door for hard working was closed, we were not happy so we opened the sides of the closed door, and we
enter and exit like germs.”
“Inform people to follow us and we will say to them we are doctors and we are diligent. Our understanding is
good; we follow our desires because people are against the rules of Shari`ah of the time of the Prophet (s).”
Astaghfirullah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) That’s why they are against the wisdoms from the time of
the Prophet (s), saying, “We should renew the rules of Shari`ah according to the understanding of this time.
We have left the door of Shari`ah and opened the door, so we enter and exit, enter and exit. Be happy with us
and applaud us! We say we are doctors and through our hard work we have agreed with the present time, the
21st century.” They don’t know that hard work over hard work won’t benefit them! A mountain over a
mountain is possible, but hard work over hard work is not possible, it is unbearable! SubhaanAllah. Allah,
Allah. Allahu Akbaru ‘l-Akbar.
This is the time of corruption and Allah Almighty has pointed to us and said:
•••••• •••• ••••••• •••••••• •••••••• ••••••• ••••••••• ••••• •••••••••• •••••••••••••
Walaw shaa rabbuka la-ja`ala ‘n-naasa ummatan waahidatan wa laa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen. If your Lord
had so willed, He could have made Mankind one people, but they will not cease to dispute. (Hud, 11:118)
They say, “Our scholars are diligent,” and the great interpreters still differ with the nation in this time of
tyrants. There is still a difference of opinion among them. The Afghans have their own fatwa, the non-Arabs
have a different fatwa, and Pakistan has a different point of view to look at the nation. They have their

different ways, and they are happy with (Germany?). Sham and Baghdad are fighting. Egypt’s scholars have
different opinions.
This shows that they still have differences of opinion and the great interpreters say that they will have
differences until the appearance of the Sahib al-Waqt, the absolute diligent one who will judge with his high
hand like Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Saahib az-Zamaan, Mahdi (a). Until his
arrival there will be differences, so now we don’t have a hope that these people will come together and follow
the Shari`ah of Allah (swt).
••••• •••••• ••••• •••••••••• •••••••••
Kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoon. Each party rejoices in that which is with itself. (al-Mu’minoon, 23:53)
It is finished, they do not agree on anything. Scholars will differ among themselves, interpreters, and great
judges until Mahdi (a) comes.
The Ghawth az-Zamaan (q) was asked about Saahib az-Zamaan (q), “Which madhhab will he follow, O our
master?” and he answered in a way to teach people, so that their hearts become content. At that time there
will not be different madhabs, but they will agree on one person and follow his judgments as absolute, just as
Saahib ash-Shari`ah gives judgment and if people do not agree they will not have any opinion until the
appearance of Mahdi (a). However, they are still differing! Astaghfirullah.
Fatihah.
Mawlana Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana, you are tired because you opened this secret. Mashaa-Allah, this is a
great secret.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. O our Lord! Your
forgiveness. O our Lord! Your forgiveness.
